_about: What households spend on one trade's item each week, by gross income tenth, poorest to richest (his message of 2026-09-25: "By purchasing power, poor middle class, wealthy, millionaire"). The published averages per household, in the country's currency; `households` the published weighted count a tenth, in thousands, so a tenth's share of the item's spending is its average times its households over the sum of the ten. `trades` maps a trade's URL slug to the item its customers buy. A tenth the source marks as too few households ("..") is not an item's tenth and the item is not drawn. United Kingdom: ONS, Family spending workbook 1, FYE 2025 (released 11 June 2026), Table A6, detailed household expenditure by gross income decile group; read 2026-09-25 (design/loop/build/research/2026-09-25-R4-customers-GB.md, the workbook 1 addendum).
